![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14246974/assets/5178d7f2910b4a28116022968e6a2d5580b9284d65bb7dc973e36f4c2a2f4ccd.png)

Given that $\overset{↔}{AB}∥\overset{↔}{CF},$ what is the measure of $∠AFB?$
question.worked_solution:
Notice that $∠BAF$  and $∠AFC$ are alternate interior angles formed when the transversal $\overset{↔}{AF}$ cuts the parallel lines $\overset{↔}{AB}$ and $\overset{↔}{CF}.$ Hence, 

$$
m∠AFC=m∠BAF={71}^{∘}.
$$

 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14246974/assets/bfb1ce1e2aba3efe901251ad40f84fda062e8324c4dd7a1f2888081724679842.png)

Also, notice that $∠FBE$  and $∠BFC$ are alternate interior angles formed when the transversal $\overset{↔}{BF}$ cuts the parallel lines $\overset{↔}{AB}$ and $\overset{↔}{CF}.$ Hence, 

$$
m∠BFC=m∠FBE={139}^{∘}.
$$

Now, using the angle addition postulate, we can find $∠AFB:$

$$
\begin{aligned}m∠AFB & =m∠BFC-m∠AFC \\  & ={139}^{∘}-{71}^{∘} \\  & ={68}^{∘}\end{aligned}
$$
